sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्पातेः प्रीतिवर्धनम् ।अङ्गप्रमुखास्तूर्णं ततः संप्रस्थिता वयम् ।। ५.३५.६७।।।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sampāteḥ prītivardhanam ।aṅgapramukhāstūrṇaṁ tataḥ saṁprasthitā vayam ।। 5.35.67।।।।

translations.english: "Having heard Sampati's encouraging words all of us led by Angada departed immediately.
